summary: Sabesp, a Brazilian water utility, filed a Form 6-K containing its 2Q26 earnings release. The report covers operational and financial results, including adjusted EPS of R$0.33 and adjusted net income down 41.2% year-over-year. It discusses capex of R$3.7 billion in 2Q26, a 1:5 stock split approved at an EGM, and cost pressures. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure, not a special situation.
